deployment.note: Version, commit and build time are stamped when the image is built (DEPLOY.md section 8). This page is read-only; redeploys are done over SSH.
deployment.failedMigrations: {count} failed migration(s): the backend may not restart. Check the logs now.
deployment.unknownBuildHint: This image was built without version info. Use the build command in DEPLOY.md section 8 to show the commit and build time.
deployment.noMigrations: Flyway history could not be read.

hint.OK: Checked hourly at the public URL. With the Cloudflare proxy on, this is Cloudflare's certificate; check the VPS certbot certificate with `certbot certificates`.
hint.EXPIRING: Less than 14 days left. On the VPS run `certbot renew --dry-run` and check the certbot timer (DEPLOY.md 10.3).
hint.EXPIRED: The certificate has expired and browsers will block the site. Renew it over SSH with certbot now.
hint.NOT_HTTPS: APP_PUBLIC_URL is not https, so there is no certificate to check (normal locally).
hint.NOT_CONFIGURED: APP_PUBLIC_URL is not set for the backend.
hint.UNREACHABLE: The backend could not complete a TLS handshake with the public URL (DNS, firewall or nginx). Retried in 10 minutes.

backups.note: Read from the backup folder mounted read-only into the backend. The app cannot create, delete or restore backups.

hint.OK: The latest backup is newer than {hours} hours.
hint.STALE: The last successful backup is older than {hours} hours. Check the cron job /etc/cron.daily/uav-pas-backup on the VPS.
hint.MISSING: The folder has no *.sql.gz files or is not mounted into the container. See DEPLOY.md sections 9 and 10.4.

backups.offsiteHint: The app has no access to the backup bucket. Check Cloudflare R2 (bucket uavpas-backups) or run `rclone ls r2backup:uavpas-backups/db/` on the VPS.
backups.restoreHint: Restores are done over SSH only, first into a scratch database (DEPLOY.md 9.4). There is no restore button here, so a misclick or a hijacked admin account cannot overwrite live data.

storage.note: Endpoint, bucket name and access keys are never shown. Bucket figures are cached for 10 minutes.
storage.cleanupWarn: Some deleted files are overdue for removal from storage or are being retried.
storage.truncated: The bucket has too many objects; figures stopped at the scan limit and are lower bounds.
storage.cacheHint: Counts every object in the bucket, including unconfirmed uploads.
storage.mediaHint: Deleted files are removed from storage by a background job; overdue means more than 1 hour past schedule.

database.note: Figures for the current database, refreshed every 30 seconds. Connection strings and accounts are never shown.
database.poolHint: Waiting threads mean the pool is exhausted: slow queries or a pool that is too small.
database.rowsHint: Row counts are PostgreSQL estimates, refreshed when autovacuum runs.

email.note: SMTP host, account and password are never shown. Change them in .env.production on the VPS and recreate the backend container.
email.enabledDetail: OTP codes, two-factor and password reset are sent by email.
email.disabledDetail: APP_MAIL_ENABLED=false: OTP codes are not delivered to users.
email.configHint: Only yes/no is shown for the SMTP host and account.
email.connectionHint: Only connects and logs in to SMTP; no message is sent. Cached for 5 minutes.
email.testHint: Goes only to your own address; at most once every {seconds} seconds.
email.noRecipient: Your account has no email address.
email.testDisabled: Enable APP_MAIL_ENABLED on the VPS to send a test.
email.testSent: Sent to {email} at {time}. Check the spam folder too.
email.testFailed: Sending failed ({error}). See the backend logs for details.

overview.intro: These pages only read the state of the infrastructure. Every change to the server is made over SSH as described in DEPLOY.md.

cards.deployment: Version, commit, Flyway migrations, HTTPS certificate expiry.
cards.backups: Daily pg_dump files on the VPS and the last successful run.
cards.storage: Cloudflare R2 usage and the media cleanup queue.
cards.database: Connections, pool, size and the largest tables.
cards.email: Mail settings, connection check, test email to yourself.
cards.health: All components at a glance, refreshed every 30 seconds.

overview.runbookIntro: The web app has no Docker or shell access: whoever takes over an admin account still cannot control the server with it.
overview.runbookFooter: Full guide: deploy/DEPLOY.md (section 8 updates, 9 backups, 10 monitoring).

restart.title: Restart / redeploy
restart.how: docker compose … up -d --build (DEPLOY.md section 8). Needs root on the VPS.

logs.title: Container logs
logs.how: docker compose … logs --tail 200 backend. Logs can contain personal data, so they are not shown on the web.

restore.title: Database restore
restore.how: Try it on a scratch database first (section 9.4). Overwriting live data cannot be undone.

secrets.title: Rotate passwords, R2 keys, SMTP
secrets.how: Edit deploy/.env.production on the VPS and recreate the containers. Secrets never pass through the web UI.

uptime.title: Downtime alerts
uptime.how: An external monitor watches /actuator/health (section 10.1); this page cannot alert when it is down itself.

mail.DOWN: Cannot connect or log in to SMTP: users will not receive OTP codes. See Infrastructure → Email.
mail.UNKNOWN: The mail connection could not be checked.

backups.DEGRADED: Backups are overdue or missing. See Infrastructure → Backups.
backups.DOWN: The backup folder could not be read.

tls.DEGRADED: The certificate has under 14 days left or is not trusted. Check certbot.
tls.UNKNOWN: Certificate not checked (APP_PUBLIC_URL unset, not https, or unreachable).

payments.DEGRADED: No receiving bank account is configured. Enter the bank details in System settings, Billing group.
payments.DOWN: Payment configuration could not be read.
payments.UNKNOWN: Payment configuration has not been checked yet.
